title: Mystic Figure with Giant Eye
description: A green-skinned figure in a purple robe and headpiece stands on a stone path holding a small red mouse. The figure has one large pink eye and stands under a giant pink eye in the sky while pink flowers float around a colorful cosmic background.
prompt: A green-skinned figure wearing a long purple robe and ornate headpiece stands on a broken stone path holding a small red mouse in one hand. The figure has one large pink eye and faces a giant cracked pink eye floating in the sky. Pink flowers and petals float through the air around the figure and a twisted tree while orange and purple clouds fill the cosmic background with small glowing structures.
